batch_node.name: deployment environment Dimension Pack v0.1.0
batch_node.description: The deployment-environment dimension pack (req-deployment-environment-pack): the family node and the two seeded environment keys, staging and production. Other environments (customer sandboxes) mint their own `deployment.environment.<name>` key on first use; no edges.

node.name: deployment.environment
node.description: The deployment-environment family. Environment membership is carried one key per environment: `deployment.environment.<name>`, valued `member`. A node or edge that belongs to an environment carries that environment's key; a node shared across environments (an identity provider, a code host) carries every key it serves — never a single key with a list, and never an unwritten 'no key means all environments' rule. Absence of a key means the node is not placed in that environment (or not observed there), nothing more. The value is always `member` in v0; the key's presence is the fact. Name aligns with OpenTelemetry's `deployment.environment.name` attribute: an OTel value `staging` maps one-to-one to the key `deployment.environment.staging`. Query a side of the grid by key presence, e.g. `MATCH (n) WHERE n.dimensions.deployment.environment.production IS NOT NULL RETURN n`. This node is the dictionary entry for the scheme; entities never carry this bare name as a key.

node.name: deployment.environment.staging
node.description: Membership in the `staging` environment: the pre-production copy of a system, where changes are exercised before production. Value `member`. Environment membership is carried one key per environment: `deployment.environment.<name>`, valued `member`.

node.name: deployment.environment.production
node.description: Membership in the `production` environment: the copy of a system that serves real users and data. Value `member`. Environment membership is carried one key per environment: `deployment.environment.<name>`, valued `member`.
